description: Recent Arrival! 2023 GMC Acadia SLT  Here are the details on the 2023 GMC Acadia SLT: what you get, how it performs, and what to watch out for. Overview The SLT trim is mid range for the 2023 Acadia lineup. It sits above the base SLE and below the more off road AT4 and luxury Denali trims. It offers a good blend of features, comfort, and performance without going into full luxury or rugged territory.  Key Specs & Performance SpecValue / Options Engines AvailableTwo choices:   A 2.0 L turbocharged 4 cylinder (standard on SLT) generating ~228 hp and 258 lb ft torque.   Also, SLT can be equipped with the 3.6 L V6 (310 hp / 271 lb ft) depending on configuration.  Transmission9 speed automatic.  Drivetrain OptionsFront wheel drive (FWD) is standard; all wheel drive (AWD) is available.  Fuel Economy (2.0L turbo / FWD)Around 22 mpg city / 29 mpg highway / about 25 mpg combined.  Towing CapacityWith the 2.0L engine: up to 3,500 lbs. With the V6: up to 4,000 lbs in properly configured models.   Dimensions, Seating, Capacity & Features ItemDetail SeatingUsually 6 or 7 passenger capacity depending on whether you have captains chairs in second row or bench. Tailored for family use.  Cargo SpaceWith all rows up, one gets modest thirdrow cargo space (~12.8 cu ft or so). With rows folded, significantly more.  Interior Comfort & AmenitiesSLT adds features over base SLE: heated front seats, optional leather or leather appointed trim, hands free power liftgate, navigation via the infotainment system.  Safety / Driver Assist / TechStandard tech includes Bluetooth, Apple CarPlay / Android Auto, multiple driver assist features depending on package, etc. More upscale packages bring premium audio, upgraded display / infotainment.    Pros  Good balance of power, features, and value  more comfort and premium touches than base models. Decent towing capacity when needed. Attractive fuel economy for the 2.0L turbo version, especially in highway driving. Flexible interior: can seat several people, fold seats, etc., so useful for families or hauling things. description: Why BUY from Dahl Honda Rhinelander?     When you choose this  2022 HONDA CR-V HYBRID TOURING with 74,318 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service!           What this vehicle includes:                                                                                                                    Safety and Security Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.
